scope: Held-out R4.3 central curves; four previously frozen configurations
external_requirement: Project p10 R4.3/M2 and p14 four correct curves/A5
independent_unit: One complete record bundle; shared inputs within a bundle, distinct leaf paths between bundles
primary_family: 88 condition/configuration NMSE means plus4 equally weighted 12-condition objective means
coverage: Approximate t/CLT finite-family mean intervals, not exact finite-sample or continuous-parameter bands
conditional_effects: Four conditional NMSE reductions and interaction; conservative bounds from92 primary intervals; separate pointwise paired95% intervals
MAE_and_counts: Descriptive means and record-level counts only; no undisclosed simultaneous coverage
precision_audit: Report actual relative half-widths against5% without changing1400 or optional stopping
execution: Unchanged R4.2 NumPy pipeline; optional process chunks use fixed record IDs; deterministic sorted merge; no numerical approximation or shortened records
p_zero: Retains Gaussian; BSC is identity with no RNG call
clean_controls: Four deterministic no-Gaussian/p0 records once, excluded from random means and intervals
central_plot: Two four-curve panels, actual tested points and92-family mean intervals; p0 separate; lines are guides between measured points
nonpositive_interval_limit: Retain numeric values; use linear/symmetric-log display when required; never replace limits by an arbitrary epsilon
